text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks simply because they were above my average cost; a gain versus my purchase price alone is not a sound reason to sell.","I should assess the whole portfolio and each stock’s future risk and expected return, rather than treating every position as a separate account or avoiding a sale to escape admitting a mistake.","Past price movements do not predict future changes, so frequent checking and trading are not an edge; I should make deliberate decisions instead of reacting to short-term noise."]}
